rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-82.1.notes: CHART. Axes: y-axis 'A' (Load (Ωs)) with ticks 0, 500, 1000, 1387; x-axis 'C' (Voltage (Vdc)) with ticks 10.5, 20, 30, 42.4. Section 'Load limitations' under '4-20 mA HART (output code A)'; page text gives 'Max. loop resistance = 43.5 (power supply voltage - 10.5)' and a 250 ohm minimum for communication. No 'Figure N' caption printed (Azure caption null is correct); the A/B/C legend is printed below the chart.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-pdf-7.description: Response time diagram: output (percent of step change) versus time after pressure is released, showing dead time Td and time constant Tc.

axes.y: percent of step change (no axis title); ticks 0%, 36.8%, 100%

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-pdf-7.notes: CHART. Axes: y-axis without title, ticks 0%, 36.8%, 100%; x-axis 'Time'. The curve stays at 100% for the dead time Td after 'Pressure released', then decays exponentially; Tc spans from the start of the decay to the 36.8% level (annotated '63.2% of total step change'). Subscripts printed as T with subscript d / c. Embedded in the 'Typical HART transmitter response time' column of the Dynamic performance table (p. 79); the Td/Tc definitions are inside the raster, not in the page text layer, so no legend key. Raster missed by Azure as a figure; the table-cell text captured its words.
